# STARC Institute (星弧)

> STARC Institute is a small nonprofit that helps university students build real products and do real research, as an alternative to the paid "background-boosting" and research-internship industry. No tuition is charged. Students pay a refundable deposit (CNY 1,000 / USD 150) that is returned in full after they complete the program, regardless of whether their project succeeds.

Key facts:
- Main program: the One-Person Company (OPC) cohort. 12 students, 8 weeks. Each student builds and launches a real product with AI tools, finds real users, and keeps a weekly public build log. Cohort 1 is for university students in mainland China; applications have not opened yet.
- Graduation is judged by evidence (a live product, real usage data, eight build logs), not by a certificate.
- Selective research track: rare openings with an active researcher; publication is never promised.
- STARC does not ghost-write, does not guarantee outcomes, does not sell follow-up courses or recommendation letters, and never charges before admission.
- Forfeited deposits pay only for operating costs; a ledger is published after each cohort.
- The team is small and unpaid; names are not listed yet.
- STARC previously charged a USD 300 operating fee for research matching; that fee has been dropped.
